properties.name: Threo Cope TS

properties.reaction_coordinate: concerted syn transfer of H15 from C7 to O6 with C2-N3 cleavage through a five-membered O6-N3-C2-C7-H15 ring; C2-N 2.097 A, O6-H25 1.280 A, C7-H25 1.328 A, C2-C7 1.431 A, N-O 1.335 A

properties.name: Threo product complex

properties.level: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP (Gaussian 16, Int=UltraFine), gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1
properties.energy_note: optimized two-fragment product complex minimum obtained by independently optimizing the threo IRC product outer frame; frequency-verified with 0 imaginary modes

properties.name: 3-phenylbut-1-ene + dimethylhydroxylamine
properties.alkene_geometry: (3S)-3-phenylbut-1-ene, stereodescriptor read from the optimized 3D geometry (same physical C7 centre as the 3R substrate; CIP label inverts because vinyl and phenyl swap priority)
properties.level: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP (Gaussian 16, Int=UltraFine), gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1
properties.energy_note: sum of the two independently optimized component minima

method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, Gaussian 16, gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1; barriers are electronic energy differences (no ZPE, no thermal correction); bond_changes use the 1-based atom indices of the mapped reactant SMILES [CH3:1][CH:2]([N+:3]([CH3:4])([CH3:5])[O-:6])[C:7]([H:15])([CH3:8])[c:9]1[cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13][cH:14]1
notes: Product-node energies for the two main channels are optimized two-fragment complex minima (about 7 kcal/mol below the separated components: hydroxylamine/alkene complexation); the alternative regioisomeric product node instead uses the sum of its component minima because no complex optimization was run for that branch, so reaction energies across branches are not directly comparable. Substrate numbering: C1 methyl hydrogens are atoms 16-18 (C1 methyl H not explicitly mapped); the regioisomeric edge lists atom 16 as the transferred methyl hydrogen, and the three methyl hydrogens are symmetry-equivalent for that transfer.
